dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.axial_tapering: Gradual, symmetrical narrowing of the visible body mass from the mid-section toward the submerged posterior peduncle.
dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.planar_edge_undulation: Smooth lateral margins with no significant asymmetrical bulges or indentations visible along the waterline.

surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.global_grayscale_baseline: Mature white; high-intensity median pixel values across the entire visible dorsal surface.

high_frequency_epidermal_anomalies.localized_point_contrast_disruptions: Multiple faint, longitudinal linear marks running parallel to the spinal axis on the right side of the dorsal surface.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Presence of healed longitudinal linear scars on the right-lateral dorsal surface.
